price_snapshot.source: RunPod live catalog supplied at launch

probe.timing_scope: cache slicing, host-to-device staging, forward/backward, gradient processing, optimizer update, complete validation, eager and weight diagnostics, checkpoint write/hash/reload, and one calibrated TEAL point

projection.a1_reference_note: A1-H uses measured A0 control boundaries.
projection.method: median of four exact end-to-end boundaries after one warm-up for each of A0, A4 kappa=0.5, and A7 kappa=0.5; measured full passes, weight statistics, and artifact operations with inventory-pass multiplicities matched to execution
projection.threshold_reference_note: Each A4/A7 threshold uses its exact topology's measured kappa=0.5 path; this is conservative if lower thresholds are faster.

run_code.newline_policy: text inputs canonicalized from CRLF to LF before hashing
